atoms.name: Positional value and base conversion
atoms.one_line: A digit $d$ at position $k$ is worth $d\cdot b^k$; divide repeatedly to convert out.

atoms.name: Binary, octal and hex grouping
atoms.one_line: 3 bits make an octal digit, 4 bits make a hex digit, grouped from the binary point.

atoms.name: Binary fractions
atoms.one_line: Bits after the point weigh $2^{-1},2^{-2},\dots$; only sums of these are exact.

atoms.name: 2's complement encode, decode, extend
atoms.one_line: Invert and add 1 to negate; copy the sign bit to extend; shift left to multiply by 2.

atoms.name: Addition and overflow
atoms.one_line: Overflow iff carry into the sign bit differs from carry out, or two like-signed operands give an opposite-signed sum.

atoms.name: Fixed-point format
atoms.one_line: $f$ fraction bits give step $2^{-f}$; unsigned range is $0..2^{i}-2^{-f}$.

atoms.name: IEEE special values and extremes
atoms.one_line: $E=0$ is zero or denormal, $E=255$ is infinity or NaN; normal $E$ runs $1..254$.

atoms.name: Floating-point arithmetic and rounding
atoms.one_line: Align exponents before adding; small terms can be absorbed, so addition is not associative.

atoms.name: Equations in an unknown base
atoms.one_line: Expand each numeral as a polynomial in $b$, solve, then check the digits are below $b$.
